objectives: Perform a safe warm-up and cool-down

days.title: Safety rules
days.work: Learn PE safety rules and personal space with a 5-minute bubble-space tag game.

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn a 6-move dynamic warm-up (jog, high knees, arm circles, skips, lunges, butt kicks).

days.title: Cool-down
days.work: Practice a static stretch cool-down and explain why muscles need it.

days.title: Active game
days.work: Play 15 minutes of freeze tag using the warm-up and cool-down routine.

days.title: Review
days.work: Lead the family through the warm-up and name 3 safety rules.

days.title: Components
days.work: Learn the 5 components of fitness and act out an exercise for each.

days.title: Pulse
days.work: Find your pulse and count heart rate at rest for 15 seconds × 4.

days.title: Heart rate change
days.work: Measure heart rate before and after 2 minutes of jumping jacks; record in a log.

days.title: Circuit
days.work: Complete a 6-station fitness circuit (one per component).

days.title: Review
days.work: Explain why heart rate rises during exercise.

days.title: Strength
days.work: Record curl-ups and 90-degree push-ups.

days.title: Flexibility
days.work: Measure sit-and-reach and shoulder stretch.

days.title: Endurance
days.work: Complete a timed half-mile walk/run or PACER and record.

days.title: Goal
days.work: Set a SMART fitness goal for the semester.

days.title: Review
days.work: Begin a weekly fitness log to track progress.

weeks.assessment: Baseline fitness scores and written goal

days.title: Locomotor review
days.work: Practice walk, run, hop, skip, gallop, slide and leap across a yard.

days.title: Pathways
days.work: Move in straight, curved and zigzag pathways around cones.

days.title: Transitions
days.work: Combine run-to-leap and skip-to-slide sequences.

days.title: Obstacle course
days.work: Complete an obstacle course with transitions.

days.title: Review
days.work: Show a 4-skill locomotor sequence.

objectives: Jump for distance and height with safe landings

days.title: Landing
days.work: Practice soft landings with bent knees.

days.title: Standing long jump
days.work: Measure 3 standing long jumps.

days.title: Vertical jump
days.work: Measure vertical jump with chalk on a wall.

days.title: Hopscotch
days.work: Play hopscotch with variations.

days.title: Review
days.work: Explain how arms help create force.

objectives: Hold balances and move along lines

days.title: Static balance
days.work: Hold balances on 1, 2, 3 and 4 body parts for 5 seconds.

days.title: Line walk
days.work: Walk forward, backward and sideways on a tape line or curb.

days.title: Partner balance
days.work: Create partner counterbalances.

days.title: Balance sequence
days.work: Create a 3-balance sequence.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform the sequence.

objectives: Link balances and rolls in a sequence
materials: mat, old mattress or soft grass

days.title: Log roll
days.work: Practice log rolls down a mat with arms overhead and body straight, 5 each direction.

days.title: Egg roll
days.work: Practice tucked side 'egg rolls' and rocking chair rocks to learn a rounded back.

days.title: Forward roll
days.work: Practice forward rolls down a gentle incline with an adult spotting the neck and hips.

days.title: Routine
days.work: Combine a balance, a roll and a jump with soft landing into a 3-part routine.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform the routine and explain the safety cue 'chin to chest.'

objectives: Jump a self-turned rope with rhythm

days.title: Sizing and turning
days.work: Size the rope to armpit height and practice turning it from the wrists without jumping.

days.title: Basic bounce
days.work: Practice the two-foot basic bounce in 5 sets of 20-second tries, resting between sets.

days.title: Count
days.work: Count consecutive jumps in 3 trials and record the best in a jump log.

days.title: Rhythm practice
days.work: Jump to a slow-tempo song, then a faster one, keeping time with the beat.

days.title: Review
days.work: Record a new personal best and explain how practice changed your count.

days.title: Skier
days.work: Learn the skier jump (side to side) and complete 3 sets of 10.

days.title: Bell
days.work: Learn the bell jump (front to back) and the side swing.

days.title: Alternate foot
days.work: Learn the alternate-foot jog step and try 20 in a row.

days.title: Heart rate
days.work: Jump for 1 minute, take your pulse, and compare it to your resting heart rate.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform 3 tricks in a row for a family member who checks them off.

days.title: Long rope
days.work: Enter, jump 5 times and exit a long rope turned by two family members (or rope tied to a fence).

days.title: Rhymes
days.work: Jump to traditional rhymes like 'Teddy Bear, Teddy Bear' and 'Cinderella.'

days.title: Routine plan
days.work: Plan a 30-second single-rope routine to music using 4 tricks.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Rehearse the routine 5 times, smoothing transitions between tricks.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform the routine and note one trick to keep improving.

days.title: Cues
days.work: Learn the cues (side to target, arm back, step with opposite foot, follow through) and shadow-throw 20 times.

days.title: Wall target
days.work: Throw 20 tennis balls at a taped wall target from 15 feet and tally hits.

days.title: Distance
days.work: Throw for distance in an open field using a big step and full follow-through; mark best throw.

days.title: Partner check
days.work: Watch a partner's throws and check off each cue on a checklist.

days.title: Review
days.work: Explain the cues and throw 10 at the target to compare accuracy with Monday.

weeks.assessment: Throw cue checklist and target tally

objectives: Catch at different levels with soft hands

days.title: Self-toss
days.work: Self-toss and catch a beanbag 20 times, then a ball, calling 'reach and give.'

days.title: Levels
days.work: Catch tosses above the head (thumbs together) and below the waist (pinkies together).

days.title: Partner
days.work: Play partner catch, taking a step back after each 3 successful catches.

days.title: Moving
days.work: Jog and catch tosses from a partner on the move.

days.title: Review
days.work: Record your best streak of consecutive partner catches.

weeks.topic: Throwing and catching on the move

days.title: Lead pass
days.work: Throw ahead of a partner running a straight cone path so they catch without stopping.

days.title: Flying disc
days.work: Learn the backhand disc throw and play catch for 15 minutes.

days.title: Football
days.work: Throw a small football with a spiral grip to a stationary then moving partner.

days.title: Feedback
days.work: Give a partner two specific compliments and one cue to improve after their throws.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a 10-pass moving drill and record completions.

objectives: Apply throwing and catching in games

days.title: Target game
days.work: Set up 10 plastic bottles and knock them down with overhand throws from a set line.

days.title: Keep-away
days.work: Play monkey in the middle, using fakes and quick passes.

days.title: Practice log
days.work: Re-test the wall target and graph your accuracy improvement since week 11.

days.title: Hit the pin
days.work: Play a family game of hit-the-pin with turn-taking and fair-play rules.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a throw and catch skill check scored on the cue checklist.

objectives: Dribble with fingertips while stationary and moving

days.title: Stationary
days.work: Dribble 30 times with each hand using fingertips at waist height.

days.title: Walking
days.work: Dribble while walking a straight line and back, switching hands at the turn.

days.title: Running
days.work: Dribble while jogging the length of a driveway or court.

days.title: Eyes up
days.work: Dribble while calling out the number of fingers a family member holds up.

days.title: Review
days.work: Dribble through a 6-cone course without losing control.

objectives: Change direction and speed while dribbling

days.title: Crossover
days.work: Learn a low crossover dribble from hand to hand and practice 3 sets of 20.

days.title: Zigzag
days.work: Dribble a zigzag cone pattern, switching hands at each cone.

days.title: Speed
days.work: Change dribbling speed when a family member calls 'red light' or 'green light.'

days.title: Dribble tag
days.work: Play dribble tag, keeping your dribble while tagging and dodging.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a dribble skills check: crossover, zigzag and speed change.

objectives: Dribble with the feet using soft touches

days.title: Touches
days.work: Practice 50 inside-foot 'toe taps' and inside-foot touches back and forth.

days.title: Cones
days.work: Dribble through a cone line using both feet and small touches.

days.title: Stop
days.work: Dribble and stop the ball with the sole of the foot on a signal.

days.title: Soccer tag
days.work: Play soccer dribble tag, protecting the ball from a defender.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a timed foot-dribble course and record your time.

objectives: Pass and kick to a target

days.title: Pass
days.work: Make 30 inside-foot passes to a partner with the plant foot beside the ball.

days.title: Target
days.work: Kick to a target between two cones from 15 feet; tally successes.

days.title: Shoot
days.work: Shoot on goal using laces and follow-through.

days.title: Moving pass
days.work: Pass to a partner jogging across the field.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a kicking check (pass accuracy and shot) scored on cues.

objectives: Use simple offense and defense strategies

days.title: Open space
days.work: Practice moving to open space to receive a pass in a 2-person keep-away.

days.title: Guarding
days.work: Practice defensive stance and staying between the attacker and the goal.

days.title: 2v1
days.work: Play 2v1 games where attackers use passes to beat one defender.

days.title: Mini game
days.work: Play a mini soccer or basketball game with family or friends.

days.title: Review
days.work: Write about one strategy you used and one fair-play moment.

objectives: Strike with a paddle with control

days.title: Balloon
days.work: Keep a balloon up with a paddle 20 times in a row.

days.title: Up bounces
days.work: Bounce a ball upward on the paddle and count consecutive hits.

days.title: Down dribble
days.work: Bounce a ball downward with the paddle like a dribble while walking.

days.title: Wall hits
days.work: Hit a ball against a wall, letting it bounce once between hits.

days.title: Review
days.work: Record your best counts for up bounces and wall hits.

days.title: Forehand cues
days.work: Learn the forehand cues (side to target, swing low to high, follow through) and shadow 20 swings.

days.title: Drop hit
days.work: Drop a ball, let it bounce and hit a forehand to a wall 20 times.

days.title: Partner rally
days.work: Rally with a partner over a rope or line, counting hits.

days.title: Target
days.work: Hit forehands to hula hoop targets near and far, adjusting force.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a forehand check scored on the 3 cues.

objectives: Strike a ball off a tee with a level swing

days.title: Grip and stance
days.work: Learn the stacked-hands grip and side stance; practice 20 dry swings.

days.title: Tee hitting
days.work: Hit 20 balls off a tee, focusing on a level swing.

days.title: Direction
days.work: Hit balls to left, center and right by adjusting your stance.

days.title: Safety
days.work: Practice the bat safety zone and placing (not throwing) the bat after hitting.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a batting check of 10 hits scored for contact and form.

objectives: Apply striking skills and placement strategy in games

days.title: Whiffle ball
days.work: Play a family whiffle ball game with tee or soft pitch.

days.title: Paddle ball
days.work: Play paddle ball over a line, scoring when the ball lands in open space.

days.title: Strategy
days.work: Discuss and test placing hits away from fielders.

days.title: Game
days.work: Play a striking game of choice and keep score fairly.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a striking unit check combining paddle and batting skills.

objectives: Move in time to a beat

days.title: Beat
days.work: March, clap and step to the beat of 4 songs with different tempos.

days.title: Levels
days.work: Dance using high, middle and low levels on a caller's signal.

days.title: Mirror
days.work: Mirror a partner's slow-motion dance moves, then switch leaders.

days.title: GoNoodle
days.work: Learn and perform a GoNoodle dance video.

days.title: Review
days.work: Create and perform an 8-count movement phrase to music.

objectives: Perform folk dances from different cultures

days.title: Virginia Reel
days.work: Learn the Virginia Reel figures (forward and back, do-si-do, reel) with family.

days.title: Jarabe Tapatío
days.work: Learn the basic heel-toe steps of the Mexican Hat Dance.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice both dances to music, counting steps aloud.

days.title: Culture
days.work: Learn where each dance comes from and why it is danced.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform both dances for family.

days.title: Grapevine
days.work: Learn the grapevine step right and left in 8 counts.

days.title: Cha-Cha Slide
days.work: Learn and dance the Cha-Cha Slide.

days.title: Electric Slide
days.work: Learn and dance the Electric Slide.

days.title: Heart rate
days.work: Dance 3 songs in a row, then measure heart rate and compare to rest.

days.title: Review
days.work: Perform a full line dance without cues.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose a song and a theme (ocean, storm, animals) and list 4 movement ideas using levels and pathways.

days.title: Create
days.work: Choreograph a 32-count dance with a beginning shape, 3 movement phrases and an ending shape.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Rehearse the dance 5 times, adding one change of tempo and one change of level.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform the dance for family and teach them one phrase.

days.title: Review
days.work: Describe how you used force, levels and pathways and what you would change.

days.title: Hula hoop pass
days.work: Pass a hula hoop around a hand-holding family circle without letting go, timing each round.

days.title: Blanket flip
days.work: Work as a group to flip a blanket over while everyone stays standing on it.

days.title: Balloon keep-up
days.work: Keep 3 balloons in the air as a team for 60 seconds using only assigned body parts.

days.title: Teamwork talk
days.work: Play 'minefield' (guiding a blindfolded partner through obstacles with words) and discuss trust.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a timed team challenge and name the encouraging words that helped.

days.title: Flag tag
days.work: Play flag tag with belt flags or tucked scarves, using open space to avoid taggers.

days.title: Dodging
days.work: Practice dodging skills (fake, pivot, change speed) in a cone-lane challenge.

days.title: Capture the flag
days.work: Play capture the flag with friends, planning offense and defense roles.

days.title: Fair play
days.work: Role-play honest calls ('I was tagged') and discuss why honesty keeps games fun.

days.title: Review
days.work: Write a short reflection on which strategy helped your team most.

days.title: Balloon volleyball
days.work: Rally a balloon over a rope net using two-hand volleys; count team hits.

days.title: Four square
days.work: Learn four square rules and play 15 minutes, using an open-palm underhand hit.

days.title: Wall ball
days.work: Rally a playground ball against a wall with a partner, alternating hits.

days.title: Rally game
days.work: Play a 2v2 balloon or beach ball game over a net, aiming for open space.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a volley skill check: 10 controlled hits to a partner.

days.title: Kickball rules
days.work: Learn kickball rules (fair/foul, outs, innings) and practice rolling pitches.

days.title: Kicking for placement
days.work: Practice kicking a rolled ball to open spaces in the field.

days.title: Base running
days.work: Practice running bases, rounding first base and tagging up, with timed runs.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a 3-inning kickball game, cheering for both teams with specific encouragement.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a game play check on kicking, fielding and sportsmanship.

days.title: Strength
days.work: Retest curl-ups and 90-degree push-ups and record in the fitness log.

days.title: Flexibility
days.work: Retest sit-and-reach and shoulder stretch after a proper warm-up.

days.title: Endurance
days.work: Retest the timed half-mile walk/run or PACER.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Graph baseline vs. current scores for each test.

days.title: Review
days.work: Write whether you met your fitness goal and what helped most.

objectives: Explain how food and water fuel activity

days.title: Hydration
days.work: Track water cups drunk before, during and after a 20-minute active play session.

days.title: Fuel
days.work: Sort snack cards into good pre-activity fuel vs. sometimes foods, then do a 15-minute jog-and-skip workout.

days.title: Circuit
days.work: Complete a 6-station fitness circuit (1 minute each) and record heart rate after each round.

days.title: Heart and lungs
days.work: Explain how heart and breathing rates changed during the circuit using your data.

days.title: Review
days.work: Complete a short quiz on fueling, hydration and the body's response to exercise.

days.title: Relays
days.work: Practice baton-pass and shuttle relays with a family member.

days.title: Sack race
days.work: Practice pillowcase sack hops and three-legged race starts.

days.title: Throw
days.work: Practice the softball throw for distance using overhand cues.

days.title: Jump
days.work: Practice standing long jump and record best of 3.

days.title: Review
days.work: Run a mini field day of 4 events and record personal results.

days.work: Compete in the 50-yard dash, standing long jump and softball throw with family or co-op friends.

days.title: Field day 2
days.work: Complete sack race, three-legged race and water-balloon toss stations.

days.title: Team relay
days.work: Run a team obstacle relay that combines dribbling, jumping and throwing skills.

days.title: Sportsmanship
days.work: Make and present sportsmanship awards to teammates, naming specific kind actions.

days.title: Review
days.work: Write a reflection comparing your field day results to your fall fitness scores.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Create a summer activity calendar with 60 minutes of activity per day across at least 4 activity types.

days.title: Try something new
days.work: Try a new activity (swimming, skateboarding, yoga) for 30 minutes and rate it.

days.title: Family outing
days.work: Go on a family hike or bike ride and measure the distance.

days.title: Log
days.work: Fill in a week of the summer activity log and set a summer skill goal (e.g., 50 consecutive rope jumps).

days.work: Share the summer plan and lead the family in your favorite warm-up.

courses.subject: HEALTH
courses.title: Health 3
courses.description: Third-grade health education covering nutrition and physical activity, body systems and growth, feelings, friendship and conflict resolution, injury prevention and safety (fire, traffic, water, emergencies, online), safe medicine use and the harms of tobacco, vaping and alcohol, and personal and community health. Students practice skills such as reading food labels, goal setting, refusal skills and handwashing, and finish with a health promotion project.
courses.framework: 2008 California Health Education Content Standards; 2019 CA Health Education Framework

standards.H-3.1.1.N: Identify the food groups and the importance of eating a variety of foods from each group.
standards.H-3.1.2.N: Describe the benefits of eating breakfast, healthy snacks and drinking water.
standards.H-3.1.3.N: Explain how physical activity contributes to good health.
standards.H-3.2.1.N: Explain how media and advertising influence food and activity choices.
standards.H-3.3.1.N: Use food labels and reliable sources to find nutrition information.
standards.H-3.5.1.N: Use a decision-making process to choose healthy foods and snacks.
standards.H-3.6.1.N: Set a short-term goal to improve eating or physical activity and track progress.
standards.H-3.7.1.N: Practice planning and preparing balanced meals and snacks.
standards.H-3.8.1.N: Encourage family and peers to make healthy food and activity choices.
standards.H-3.1.1.G: Describe the major body systems (skeletal, muscular, digestive, circulatory, respiratory, nervous) and their functions.
standards.H-3.1.2.G: Explain how the five senses work and how to protect them.
standards.H-3.1.3.G: Recognize that people grow and develop at different rates.
standards.H-3.3.1.G: Identify trusted adults and professionals who can answer questions about growth and the body.
standards.H-3.7.1.G: Practice behaviors that keep body systems healthy.
standards.H-3.1.1.S: Identify safety rules at home, at school and in the community (fire, water, bicycle, pedestrian, passenger).
standards.H-3.1.2.S: Describe emergency situations and how to get help, including calling 911.
standards.H-3.1.3.S: Distinguish between safe and unsafe situations and identify trusted adults to tell.
standards.H-3.1.4.S: Identify ways to stay safe online and with technology.
standards.H-3.4.1.S: Demonstrate refusal skills and how to ask for help in unsafe situations.
standards.H-3.5.1.S: Use a decision-making process to avoid injury.
standards.H-3.7.1.S: Practice safety behaviors (helmets, seat belts, fire escape plans).
standards.H-3.1.1.A: Distinguish between medicines and other drugs and describe safe medicine use.
standards.H-3.1.2.A: Describe the harmful effects of tobacco, vaping and secondhand smoke.
standards.H-3.1.3.A: Describe the effects of alcohol on the body and behavior.
standards.H-3.2.1.A: Identify influences such as media and peers on alcohol, tobacco and drug use.
standards.H-3.4.1.A: Demonstrate refusal skills to avoid alcohol, tobacco and other drugs.
standards.H-3.8.1.A: Encourage others to be tobacco-, alcohol- and drug-free.
standards.H-3.1.1.M: Identify feelings and healthy ways to express them.
standards.H-3.1.2.M: Describe characteristics of healthy friendships and respect for differences.
standards.H-3.1.3.M: Describe bullying and ways to respond to and report it.
standards.H-3.4.1.M: Demonstrate effective communication, listening and conflict-resolution skills.
standards.H-3.5.1.M: Use a decision-making process for social situations.
standards.H-3.6.1.M: Set a personal goal and identify steps and supports to reach it.
standards.H-3.7.1.M: Practice healthy ways to manage stress and strong emotions.
standards.H-3.1.1.P: Explain how germs spread and how to prevent communicable disease.
standards.H-3.1.2.P: Describe proper dental care and its importance.
standards.H-3.1.3.P: Explain the importance of sleep, sun protection and personal hygiene.
standards.H-3.1.4.P: Describe how the environment affects health and ways to protect it.
standards.H-3.3.1.P: Identify health care professionals and community health helpers.
standards.H-3.7.1.P: Practice personal hygiene and health habits.
standards.H-3.8.1.P: Promote a healthy school, home and community environment.

units.title: Nutrition and Physical Activity
units.big_idea: A variety of foods and daily activity give our bodies the energy to learn, play and grow.

units.title: Growth and Development: Body Systems
units.big_idea: Body systems work together, and healthy habits keep them strong.

units.title: Mental, Emotional and Social Health
units.big_idea: Understanding feelings and communicating well help us build healthy relationships.

units.title: Injury Prevention and Safety
units.big_idea: Knowing safety rules and how to get help prevents injuries.

units.title: Medicines, Alcohol, Tobacco and Other Drugs
units.big_idea: Medicines can help when used safely; tobacco, vaping and alcohol harm growing bodies.

days.work: Mash crackers with water in a zip bag to model the stomach.

days.title: Intestine length
days.work: Measure a string as long as the small intestine (about 20 feet) and lay it out.

days.title: Fiber and water
days.work: Discuss how fiber and water help digestion.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write the digestion steps in order.

objectives: Describe the circulatory and respiratory systems

days.title: Heart
days.work: Learn the heart is a muscle that pumps blood; listen to a heartbeat through a paper towel tube.

days.title: Pulse
days.work: Measure pulse before and after exercise and graph results.

days.title: Lungs model
days.work: Build a balloon-lung model in a plastic bottle and demonstrate breathing.

days.title: Protect
days.work: List ways to protect the heart and lungs (exercise, no smoke).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how the heart and lungs work together.

objectives: Describe the nervous system and five senses

days.title: Brain
days.work: Learn the brain's role as the control center and why helmets matter.

days.title: Reaction time
days.work: Do the ruler-drop reaction test 5 times and record results.

days.title: Senses test
days.work: Do a blindfolded taste and smell test.

days.title: Protect senses
days.work: List ways to protect eyes and ears (sunglasses, volume limits).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a senses chart with organ, job and protection.

objectives: Recognize people grow at different rates

days.title: Growth
days.work: Compare baby photos to now and measure your height.

days.title: Different rates
days.work: Discuss why kids grow at different rates and that it is normal.

days.title: Trusted adults
days.work: List trusted adults and professionals to ask about body questions.

days.title: Doctor visit
days.work: Learn what happens at a check-up.

days.title: Unit 2 check
days.work: Complete a quiz on body systems and growth.

objectives: Identify feelings and healthy ways to express them

days.title: Feelings words
days.work: Build a feelings word bank of 20 emotions.

days.title: Body signals
days.work: Identify where you feel anger, worry and excitement in your body.

days.title: Expressing
days.work: Sort healthy and unhealthy ways to express anger.

days.title: Journal
days.work: Write a feelings journal entry about your day.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Role-play expressing a feeling using an I-message.

days.title: What is stress
days.work: Discuss what stress feels like and list 5 things that cause you stress.

days.title: Breathing
days.work: Practice belly breathing and 5-finger breathing (trace your hand while breathing in and out) for 3 minutes.

days.title: Calm-down kit
days.work: Build a calm-down kit in a shoebox with a stress ball, drawing paper, a favorite book and breathing cards.

days.title: Move it out
days.work: Try 3 movement stress relievers (stretching, a brisk walk, a dance break) and rate how each felt.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a calm-down plan poster listing your 4 best strategies in order.

materials: friendship picture book (e.g., 'The Invisible Boy' by Trudy Ludwig, library)

days.title: Friend qualities
days.work: List 8 qualities of a good friend and rank your top 3.

days.title: Empathy
days.work: Read 'The Invisible Boy' (or similar) and discuss how Brian felt and what changed.

days.title: Differences
days.work: Interview a friend or relative about something different about them and something you share.

days.title: Inclusion
days.work: Plan 3 ways to include someone left out at a park, co-op or team practice.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a 'recipe for friendship' with ingredients and steps.

objectives: Demonstrate active listening, I-messages and conflict-resolution steps

days.title: Active listening
days.work: Practice active listening: partner tells a story, you repeat back the main points and a feeling.

days.title: I-messages
days.work: Write I-messages ('I feel ___ when ___ because ___') for 5 common conflicts.

days.title: Conflict steps
days.work: Learn 5 steps (cool down, talk, listen, brainstorm, agree) and make a pocket card.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Role-play solving a sibling conflict over a shared toy using the steps.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain the conflict-resolution steps and when you would use them.

objectives: Describe bullying and ways to respond to and report it

days.title: What is bullying
days.work: Read the KidsHealth article on bullying and distinguish bullying (repeated, power imbalance) from ordinary conflict.

days.title: Types
days.work: Sort scenario cards into physical, verbal, social and cyberbullying.

days.title: Upstander
days.work: Practice 4 upstander responses (speak up, stay with the target, walk away together, get help).

days.title: Reporting
days.work: Practice telling a trusted adult the who, what, where and when of a bullying incident.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write and sign an upstander pledge.

objectives: Set a personal goal and identify steps and supports

days.title: Growth mindset
days.work: Turn 6 fixed-mindset statements ('I can't do this') into growth-mindset statements ('I can't do this yet').

days.title: Choose a goal
days.work: Set a personal goal (learn to ride without training wheels, read a chapter book, make a new friend).

days.title: Steps and supports
days.work: List 4 steps toward the goal and the people who can support you.

days.title: Track
days.work: Track progress on a 2-week calendar and note obstacles.

days.title: Unit 3 check
days.work: Complete a quiz on feelings, stress, friendship, conflict and bullying.

objectives: Make and practice a home escape plan

days.title: Fire rules
days.work: Learn rules about matches, lighters, stoves and space heaters, and find hazards in a home picture.

days.title: Smoke alarms
days.work: Test home smoke alarms with an adult and learn what the sound means.

days.title: Escape plan
days.work: Draw a home floor plan with two exits from every room and an outside meeting place.

days.title: Fire drill
days.work: Practice a home fire drill, crawling low under 'smoke' and timing how long it takes.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate stop, drop and roll and explain your escape plan.

objectives: Practice safety rules for walking, biking and riding in vehicles

days.title: Pedestrian
days.work: Walk a neighborhood route with an adult practicing stop-look-listen and crosswalk rules.

days.title: Helmet fit
days.work: Fit your helmet using the eyes-ears-mouth test from Safe Kids.

days.title: Bike rules
days.work: Learn bike hand signals and ride a safe route, signaling turns.

days.title: Car safety
days.work: Learn California booster seat rules and the 5-step seat belt fit test.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a pedestrian, bike and passenger safety checklist.

objectives: Identify water, heat and sun safety rules

days.title: Water rules
days.work: Learn pool, lake and ocean safety rules, including what a rip current is and how to escape one.

days.title: Life jackets
days.work: Try on a life jacket and check it is the right size and fastened correctly.

days.title: Buddy system
days.work: Practice the buddy system and 'reach or throw, don't go' rescue rule.

days.title: Decisions
days.work: Use decide-act-check steps for 4 outdoor scenarios (thunderstorm at the beach, getting lost on a hike).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a water safety poster with 5 rules.

objectives: Describe emergencies and practice getting help

days.title: Emergency or not
days.work: Sort 12 situations into emergencies (call 911) and non-emergencies (tell an adult).

days.title: Calling 911
days.work: Practice a pretend 911 call stating your name, full address and what happened.

days.title: First aid
days.work: Learn basic first aid for small cuts, scrapes and nosebleeds and tour the home first aid kit.

days.title: Earthquake
days.work: Practice drop, cover and hold on in 3 rooms and identify safe spots.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make an emergency contact card with address, phone numbers and a trusted neighbor.

days.title: Safe vs. unsafe
days.work: Sort 10 scenario cards into safe, unsafe or 'check with an adult.'

days.title: Trusted adults
days.work: Draw a 'helping hand' tracing with 5 trusted adults, one on each finger.

days.title: Refusal skills
days.work: Practice 'say no, get away, tell someone' with firm voice and body language.

days.title: Body safety
days.work: Learn body safety rules: your body belongs to you and secrets about touching are never okay to keep.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Role-play 3 refusal scenarios with a parent.

objectives: Identify ways to stay safe online

days.title: Personal information
days.work: Sort information into okay to share online (favorite color) and private (address, school, photos).

days.title: Passwords
days.work: Create a strong passphrase and learn why passwords are shared only with parents.

days.title: Online strangers
days.work: Discuss what to do if someone online asks personal questions or to meet.

days.title: Family agreement
days.work: Write a family technology agreement with screen time, apps and rules.

days.title: Unit 4 check
days.work: Complete a quiz on fire, traffic, water, emergency and online safety.

days.title: Medicine vs. drug
days.work: Define medicine and drug and sort examples.

days.title: Labels
days.work: Read an over-the-counter medicine box for dosage, age and warnings.

days.title: Safe use
days.work: Learn the rule: take medicine only from a parent or trusted adult, never alone.

days.title: Look-alikes
days.work: Compare pictures of candy and medicine look-alikes and explain the danger.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write 5 medicine safety rules for a younger child.

objectives: Describe the harmful effects of tobacco, vaping and secondhand smoke

days.title: Effects
days.work: Compare images of healthy and smoker's lungs and list effects on the heart and lungs.

days.title: Vaping
days.work: Read a kid-level article on vaping and learn that vapes contain addictive nicotine.

days.title: Secondhand smoke
days.work: Discuss secondhand smoke and how to avoid it.

days.title: Influences
days.work: Identify how flavors, packaging and peers can make vaping seem appealing.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write 5 facts about tobacco and vaping.

objectives: Describe the effects of alcohol on the body and behavior

days.title: Effects
days.work: Learn how alcohol slows the brain, affecting judgment, balance and reaction time.

days.title: Coordination
days.work: Try walking a line while spinning in place (with an adult) to model impaired balance, then discuss.

days.title: Growing bodies
days.work: Discuss why alcohol is especially harmful to growing brains and why the legal age is 21.

days.title: Influences
days.work: Identify alcohol messages in ads and media.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Answer 6 questions about alcohol's effects.

days.title: Peer pressure
days.work: Define peer pressure and list positive and negative examples.

days.title: Refusal strategies
days.work: Learn 5 ways to say no (say no firmly, give a reason, change the subject, walk away, suggest something else).

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Role-play refusing a vape or alcohol offer in 3 scenarios.

days.title: Poster
days.work: Design a drug-free poster with a positive message for kids.

days.title: Unit 5 check
days.work: Complete a quiz on medicines, tobacco, alcohol and refusal skills.

days.title: Germs
days.work: Learn the difference between bacteria and viruses and how they spread.

days.title: Glitter germs
days.work: Put lotion and glitter 'germs' on hands, shake hands with family, and see how far they spread.

days.title: Handwashing
days.work: Practice the CDC 5-step handwashing method for 20 seconds, then test with glitter.

days.title: Cough and sneeze
days.work: Spray a water bottle 'sneeze' at paper to see droplet spread, then practice covering with an elbow.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a handwashing sign for the bathroom with all 5 steps.

days.title: Teeth
days.work: Learn tooth parts and types (incisors, canines, molars) using a mirror.

days.title: Egg experiment
days.work: Soak one hard-boiled egg in soda and one in water overnight and compare stains on the 'enamel.'

days.title: Brushing
days.work: Watch a Mouth Healthy Kids video and practice brushing for 2 minutes with a timer.

days.title: Flossing
days.work: Practice flossing technique on all teeth.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Start a 2-week brushing and flossing tracker.

objectives: Explain the importance of sleep, sun protection and personal hygiene

days.title: Sleep
days.work: Learn that 8–12-year-olds need 9–12 hours of sleep and why the brain needs it.

days.title: Sleep log
days.work: Track bedtime, wake time and hours slept for 5 nights.

days.title: Sun protection
days.work: Learn sun safety (SPF 30+, hats, shade) and test sunscreen on UV beads or dark paper in the sun.

days.title: Hygiene routine
days.work: Create a morning and evening hygiene checklist (bathing, hair, nails, clean clothes).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Analyze your sleep log and set a bedtime goal.

weeks.assessment: Sleep log analysis and hygiene checklist

objectives: Identify health care professionals and community health helpers

days.title: Helpers
days.work: List health helpers (doctor, nurse, dentist, pharmacist, school nurse, optometrist) and what each does.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a health worker (in person or by phone) with 5 prepared questions.

days.title: Pharmacy
days.work: Visit a pharmacy counter and learn how pharmacists keep medicine safe.

days.title: Public health
days.work: Learn how public health workers keep water, food and restaurants safe.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a 'health helpers' booklet with one page per helper.

objectives: Describe how the environment affects health and how to protect it

days.title: Pollution
days.work: Learn how air and water pollution can affect breathing and health.

days.title: Air quality
days.work: Check the daily Air Quality Index on AirNow for a week and decide which days are good for outdoor play.

days.title: Trash audit
days.work: With gloves, sort one day of household trash into landfill, recycling and compost and weigh each.

days.title: Reduce plan
days.work: Write a family plan to reduce, reuse and recycle 3 items.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a paragraph on how a clean environment keeps people healthy.

objectives: Promote a healthy community environment through action

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose a park, beach or street to clean and plan supplies and safety rules.

days.title: Cleanup
days.work: Carry out a 1-hour cleanup with family and tally types of trash collected.

days.title: Data
days.work: Graph the trash collected and identify the most common item.

days.title: Share
days.work: Write a short letter or post for a community board sharing results and a request to help.

days.title: Unit 6 check
days.work: Complete a quiz on germs, dental care, sleep, health helpers and the environment.

objectives: Plan a health promotion campaign for a chosen audience

days.title: Topic
days.work: Choose a health topic from the year (eat a rainbow, wash hands, helmet use, drug-free) to promote.

days.title: Audience
days.work: Choose an audience (younger cousins, co-op class, family) and what they need to know.

days.title: Message
days.work: Write a clear, positive message with 3 supporting facts.

days.title: Plan materials
days.work: Plan materials: a poster, a brochure and a 1-minute public service announcement.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Share the plan with a parent and revise it.

days.title: Poster
days.work: Create a campaign poster with a catchy slogan and picture.

days.title: Brochure
days.work: Make a tri-fold brochure with facts and tips.

days.title: PSA script
days.work: Write a 1-minute PSA script.

days.title: Record
days.work: Record the PSA video or audio.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Check all facts against KidsHealth or MyPlate and practice presenting.

weeks.topic: Health promotion project: present and reflect

days.title: Present
days.work: Present the campaign to your chosen audience.

days.title: Feedback
days.work: Ask the audience what they learned and one change they will make.

days.title: Final quiz
days.work: Take the end-of-year health quiz covering all units.

days.title: Summer goals
days.work: Set 2 summer health goals (activity, nutrition, sleep or safety).

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Write a reflection on the healthiest change you made this year.
